description: Combined per-user and per-bucket S3 usage and performance. Filters: RGW instance, user and bucket. Usage and quota panels (stored/used bytes, objects, compression, bucket and user quotas) come from the usage and quota metrics and respect all three filters. User-level performance panels respect RGW instance and user, and are narrowed to the owners of the selected bucket(s). Bucket-level performance panels respect RGW instance and bucket, and are narrowed to the buckets of the selected user(s).

panels.description: Number of buckets in the selection (usage metric). Respects RGW instance, user and bucket.

targets.expr: count((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Buckets

panels.description: Number of users owning at least one bucket in the selection (usage metric). Respects RGW instance, user and bucket.

targets.expr: count(count by (owner) ((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))))

panels.title: Users

panels.description: Bytes currently stored by the selected users/buckets (usage metric). Respects RGW instance, user and bucket.

targets.expr: sum((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Used Bytes

panels.description: Number of objects currently stored by the selected users/buckets (usage metric). Respects RGW instance, user and bucket.

targets.expr: sum((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_objects{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Object Count

panels.description: Average size per stored object (used bytes / object count, usage metrics). Respects RGW instance, user and bucket.

targets.expr: sum((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))) / (sum((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_objects{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))) > 0)

panels.title: Avg Object Size

panels.description: Cumulative bytes uploaded (PUT) and downloaded (GET) in the selected buckets (per-bucket performance counters). Respects RGW instance and bucket; when a user is selected only that user's buckets are shown. Counters are matched to buckets by name, tenant and the zone of the serving RGW daemon, so same-named buckets are listed separately per owner.

targets.expr: sum((((ceph_rgw_op_per_bucket_put_obj_bytes{bucket=~"$bucket"}) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) * on (bucket, tenant, zone) group_left (owner) group by (bucket, tenant, zone, owner) (ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"})))

sum((((ceph_rgw_op_per_bucket_get_obj_bytes{bucket=~"$bucket"}) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) * on (bucket, tenant, zone) group_left (owner) group by (bucket, tenant, zone, owner) (ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"})))

panels.title: PUT / GET Bytes

panels.description: Cumulative PUT and GET object operation counts in the selected buckets (per-bucket performance counters). Respects RGW instance and bucket; when a user is selected only that user's buckets are shown. Counters are matched to buckets by name, tenant and the zone of the serving RGW daemon, so same-named buckets are listed separately per owner.

targets.expr: sum((((ceph_rgw_op_per_bucket_put_obj_ops{bucket=~"$bucket"}) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) * on (bucket, tenant, zone) group_left (owner) group by (bucket, tenant, zone, owner) (ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"})))

sum((((ceph_rgw_op_per_bucket_get_obj_ops{bucket=~"$bucket"}) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) * on (bucket, tenant, zone) group_left (owner) group by (bucket, tenant, zone, owner) (ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"})))

panels.title: PUT / GET Ops

panels.description: Used Bytes : Utilized Bytes (size after compression and encryption), shown as N:1. Values above 1:1 mean data is compressed. Respects RGW instance, user and bucket.

targets.expr: sum((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))) / (sum((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes_utilized{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))) > 0)

panels.title: Compression Ratio

panels.description: Sum of the byte quotas of the selected buckets that have a quota enabled (ceph_rgw_bucket_quota_bytes). Buckets without a quota are not counted. Respects RGW instance, user and bucket.

targets.expr: sum((ceph_rgw_bucket_quota_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Bucket Max Bytes

panels.description: Sum of the object quotas of the selected buckets that have a quota enabled (ceph_rgw_bucket_quota_objects). Buckets without a quota are not counted. Respects RGW instance, user and bucket.

targets.expr: sum((ceph_rgw_bucket_quota_objects{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Bucket Max Objects

panels.description: Used Bytes / byte quota, over the selected buckets that have a byte quota.

targets.expr: sum((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (zone, tenant, owner, bucket) (ceph_rgw_bucket_quota_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))) / sum((ceph_rgw_bucket_quota_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Bucket Used (Bytes)

panels.description: Object Count / object quota, over the selected buckets that have an object quota.

targets.expr: sum((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_objects{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (zone, tenant, owner, bucket) (ceph_rgw_bucket_quota_objects{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))) / sum((ceph_rgw_bucket_quota_objects{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Bucket Used (Objects)

panels.description: Sum of the user/account byte quotas (ceph_rgw_owner_quota_bytes) of the selected users, or of the owners of the selected buckets. Users without a quota are not counted. Owner quotas have no bucket label, so the bucket filter only narrows the list of owners.

targets.expr: sum((ceph_rgw_owner_quota_bytes{owner=~"$user"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)") and on (zone, tenant, owner) ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{bucket=~"$bucket"}))

panels.title: User Max Bytes

panels.description: Sum of the user/account object quotas (ceph_rgw_owner_quota_objects) of the selected users, or of the owners of the selected buckets. Users without a quota are not counted. Owner quotas have no bucket label, so the bucket filter only narrows the list of owners.

targets.expr: sum((ceph_rgw_owner_quota_objects{owner=~"$user"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)") and on (zone, tenant, owner) ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{bucket=~"$bucket"}))

panels.title: User Max Objects

panels.description: Bytes stored in all buckets of the user(s) / user byte quota, over the users that have a byte quota. Not narrowed to the selected buckets, because the user quota applies to all of the user's buckets.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (zone, tenant, owner) ((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))) and on (zone, tenant, owner) (ceph_rgw_owner_quota_bytes{owner=~"$user"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)") and on (zone, tenant, owner) ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{bucket=~"$bucket"})) / sum((ceph_rgw_owner_quota_bytes{owner=~"$user"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)") and on (zone, tenant, owner) ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{bucket=~"$bucket"}))

panels.title: User Used (Bytes)

panels.description: Objects in all buckets of the user(s) / user object quota, over the users that have an object quota. Not narrowed to the selected buckets, because the user quota applies to all of the user's buckets.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (zone, tenant, owner) ((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_objects{owner=~"$user"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))) and on (zone, tenant, owner) (ceph_rgw_owner_quota_objects{owner=~"$user"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)") and on (zone, tenant, owner) ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{bucket=~"$bucket"})) / sum((ceph_rgw_owner_quota_objects{owner=~"$user"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)") and on (zone, tenant, owner) ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{bucket=~"$bucket"}))

panels.title: User Used (Objects)

panels.description: Used Bytes per bucket over time (usage metric, gauge).

targets.expr: sum by (owner, bucket) ((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Storage Usage Trend

panels.description: Objects per bucket over time (usage metric, gauge).

targets.expr: sum by (owner, bucket) ((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_objects{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Object Count Trend

panels.description: Used Bytes : Utilized Bytes per bucket over time.

targets.expr: sum by (owner, bucket) ((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))) / (sum by (owner, bucket) ((ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes_utilized{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"} and on (zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)"))) > 0)

panels.title: Compression Ratio Trend

panels.description: Cumulative operation counts per user (per-user performance counters, summed over the selected RGW instance). Respects RGW instance and user; when a bucket is selected only the owners of that bucket are shown, with their totals over all of their buckets.

targets.expr: sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_put_obj_ops) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)")))

sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_get_obj_ops) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)")))

sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_list_obj_ops) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)")))

sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_del_obj_ops) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)")))

sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_copy_obj_ops) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)")))

panels.title: User Operation Summary

panels.description: Average latency per operation (lat_sum / lat_count of the per-user performance counters, converted to milliseconds) per user. Respects RGW instance and user; when a bucket is selected only the owners of that bucket are shown, with their totals over all of their buckets.

targets.expr: 1000 * sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_put_obj_lat_sum) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)"))) / (sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_put_obj_lat_count) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)"))) > 0)

1000 * sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_get_obj_lat_sum) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)"))) / (sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_get_obj_lat_count) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)"))) > 0)

1000 * sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_list_obj_lat_sum) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)"))) / (sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_list_obj_lat_count) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)"))) > 0)

1000 * sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_del_obj_lat_sum) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)"))) / (sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_del_obj_lat_count) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)"))) > 0)

1000 * sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_copy_obj_lat_sum) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)"))) / (sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_copy_obj_lat_count) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)"))) > 0)

panels.title: User Average Latency (ms)

panels.description: Cumulative PUT operations per user (per-user performance counters). Respects RGW instance and user; when a bucket is selected only the owners of that bucket are shown, with their totals over all of their buckets.

targets.expr: topk(5, sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_put_obj_ops) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)"))))

panels.title: Top 5 User PUTs by Operations

panels.description: Cumulative GET operations per user (per-user performance counters). Respects RGW instance and user; when a bucket is selected only the owners of that bucket are shown, with their totals over all of their buckets.

targets.expr: topk(5, sum by (user) ((((ceph_rgw_op_per_user_get_obj_ops) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)"))))

panels.title: Top 5 User GETs by Operations

panels.description: Upload throughput (bytes/s) per user from per-user performance counters. This is traffic, not stored capacity. Respects RGW instance and user; when a bucket is selected only the owners of that bucket are shown, with their totals over all of their buckets.

targets.expr: sum by (user) ((((rate(ceph_rgw_op_per_user_put_obj_bytes[$__rate_interval])) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)")))

panels.title: User PUT Throughput

panels.description: Download throughput (bytes/s) per user from per-user performance counters. This is traffic, not stored capacity. Respects RGW instance and user; when a bucket is selected only the owners of that bucket are shown, with their totals over all of their buckets.

targets.expr: sum by (user) ((((rate(ceph_rgw_op_per_user_get_obj_bytes[$__rate_interval])) * on (instance_id) group_left (ceph_daemon, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_metadata{ceph_daemon=~"$rgw_instance", cluster=~"$cluster|", }, "zone", "$1", "zone_id", "(.+)")) and on (user, tenant, zone) label_replace(ceph_rgw_bucket_usage_bytes{owner=~"$user", bucket=~"$bucket"}, "user", "$1", "owner", "(?:[^$]*\\$)?(.+)")))

panels.title: User GET Throughput
